title: American Convention on Human Rights Article 8 — Right to a Fair Trial and Due Process Guarantees
category: International Aviation / Human Rights / Treaty Law

incident.date: 2024-07-05 (initial removal); ongoing through 2024-04-04 (GRU re-assertion of ban) and present
incident.location: Santiago International Airport (SCL), DGAC offices, Chile / Guarulhos International Airport (GRU), Brazil

incident_timestamp_display: 2024-07-05 (initial removal); ongoing through 2024-04-04 (GRU re-assertion of ban) and present
allegation_summary: Article 8 of the ACHR guarantees the right to a hearing by a competent, independent, and impartial tribunal in the determination of one's rights and obligations, and establishes minimum due process guarantees including presumption of innocence, prior notification of charges, adequate time and means for defense, and the right to counsel. In this case, the passenger was subjected to determinations affecting his civil rights (removal from flight, lifetime ban, reputational harm) without any hearing whatsoever. Key Article 8 violations include: (a) no hearing before any tribunal or competent authority — the removal was ordered by airline crew and enforced by PDI without any judicial or administrative review; (b) the presumption of innocence (Art. 8(2)) was violated by treating the passenger as guilty of aggression without any evidence, let alone proof according to law; (c) no prior notification of charges (Art. 8(2)(b)) — the passenger was never formally charged or informed of the specific allegations in a procedurally adequate manner; (d) no opportunity to prepare a defense (Art. 8(2)(c)) or to examine witnesses (Art. 8(2)(f)) — the crew's allegation was accepted at face value without any adversarial process.

articles.article_text: The States Parties to this Convention undertake to respect the rights and freedoms recognized herein and to ensure to all persons subject to their jurisdiction the free and full exercise of those rights and freedoms, without any discrimination for reasons of race, color, sex, language, religion, political or other opinion, national or social origin, economic status, birth, or any other social condition.
